description.value: Through a combination of magic and Kuthite arts, you tend to get your way. When you succeed at an Intimidation check to [[/act coerce]] a creature you can freely inflict pain upon (usually by having them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]), you get a critical success instead, and the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against you for as long as they comply with your directives.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
